animation.capabilities.summary: Discover stable AnimationManager availability and class-level collection/workspace API exposure without evaluating the storyboards getter or activating a workspace.
limitations: Availability flags describe class descriptors/methods, not initialized document data or successful execution. collectionAccess is notChecked and count is null; no Storyboards instance is retrieved. Inspect individual storyboards after explicit workspace activation for play/activate/seek exposure.
No stable action-creation interface, video publishing or assumed stop method in this supported SDK profile.

animation.list.summary: List native storyboards with document creationId/index refs, duration, playhead and exposed methods; no workspace switch.
limitations: Requires an already active Animation workspace. Inactive or uninitialized data produces an actionable explicit animation.workspace requirement, never implicit initialization or an empty-list substitute.
No name/id properties assumed. Zero-based indices are not persistent after reorder, insertion or deletion; relist before use.

animation.inspect.summary: Inspect an existing storyboard without activating it or its workspace.

inputs.storyboard: Exact {document: document creationId, index: zero-based integer} ref returned by animation.list; not persistent after collection changes.

limitations: Requires an already active Animation workspace. Inactive or uninitialized data requires explicit animation.workspace with confirm:true before retry; inspection never initializes data.
Read-only state observation, not action enumeration. Relist after reorder; no persistent storyboard identifier is claimed.

animation.workspace.summary: Explicitly activate the scoped design's Animation workspace using AnimationManager.activateAnimationWorkspace.

inputs.confirm: Must be true. Changes workspace/UI state.

limitations: Calls the workspace API without accessing storyboards, including before animation data is initialized. No collection readiness claim is made.
No automatic workspace restoration or document save. Requires no interactive command. Shared CAD wrapper may activate the target document for mutating commands.

animation.create.summary: Create a real native storyboard with Storyboards.add(clean), returning its document/index ref.

inputs.confirm: Must be true; creates a document object.
inputs.clean: Boolean, default true: initial design transforms. False inherits previous storyboard transforms per SDK.
inputs.activate: Boolean, default false. Explicit opt-in to activate Animation workspace; otherwise it must already be active.

limitations: No name/id setters or actions are invented. Native creation may change active storyboard. No video publishing, save or rollback.

Explicit activate:true initializes an inactive workspace before accessing its collection; collection-level validation can still fail afterward. Refs are document creationId/index, not persistent after reorder. Shared wrapper may activate the scoped document.

animation.activate.summary: Activate an existing native storyboard using its exposed activate method.

inputs.storyboard: Document creationId/index ref from a fresh animation.list.
inputs.confirm: Must be true; changes active storyboard and view.
inputs.activate: Boolean, default false. Explicit workspace activation opt-in.

limitations: No automatic restoration. Missing stable methods fail explicitly. Explicit activate:true precedes collection-level validation when the workspace is inactive; activation may remain if later validation fails. Shared wrapper may activate the scoped document.

animation.play.summary: Start playback of an already active storyboard; returns status:started and completed:false, not a completion claim.

inputs.storyboard: Fresh document creationId/index ref; storyboard must already be active.
inputs.activate: Boolean, default false; opt in to workspace activation only, not storyboard activation.
inputs.end: Finite seconds; default storyboard.end. Requires 0 <= begin < end <= storyboard.end.

limitations: No polling, background callback, guessed stop method or completion wait. Empty storyboards cannot play a positive interval.

Explicit activate:true precedes collection/interval validation when the workspace is inactive; activation may remain if later validation fails. Shared wrapper may activate the scoped document. No action creation or video publishing.

animation.seek.summary: Set an already active storyboard's exposed writable playheadPosition in seconds.

inputs.storyboard: Fresh document creationId/index ref to an already active storyboard.
inputs.seconds: Finite seconds within 0..storyboard.end, or -1 for scratch zone.
inputs.confirm: Must be true; changes playback/view state.
inputs.activate: Boolean, default false; explicit workspace activation opt-in.

limitations: No fake fallback if the property is unavailable/read-only. Explicit activate:true precedes collection/interval validation when the workspace is inactive; activation may remain if later validation fails. Shared wrapper may activate the scoped document. No restoration or video output.

motion.sample.summary: Synchronously sample explicit joint tracks through compiled joint.drive handlers, return actual joint values/checks/optional PNG files, and restore motion/camera by default in finally.

inputs.tracks: 1..64 distinct Joint/AsBuiltJoint tracks: {joint:token-ref, rotation?:{from:angle-expression,to:angle-expression}, slide?:{from:length-expression,to:length-expression}}. At least one supported DOF per track.
inputs.frameCount: Integer 2..240 inclusive. Linear interpolation includes both endpoints; all values/limits are validated before motion.
inputs.confirm: Must be true even when restoring; joint.drive may capture position snapshots.
inputs.restore: Boolean, default true. Restore all exposed rotation/slide values on tracked joints and camera in finally; errors reported separately. False deliberately leaves the final/partial pose.
inputs.checks: Optional array, at most 64 existing check command inputs. Validated read-only at initial pose and evaluated per sampled pose; failed acceptance makes passed:false.
inputs.frameFiles: Optional array of exactly frameCount distinct .png paths. CLI maps WSL/native paths like other exports; handler receives absolute native Fusion-machine paths. Existing parents required; no overwrite. Do not supply with directory/prefix.
inputs.directory: Optional output directory, CLI-mapped from WSL/native paths like other exports. Must already exist on the Fusion machine; creates prefix-000.png etc., never the directory. No default directory or overwrite.
inputs.prefix: Optional filename prefix with 1..64 ASCII letters/digits/_/-, default frame; requires directory.
inputs.width: Optional PNG width, integer 32..4096, default 1280; requires targets.
inputs.height: Optional PNG height, integer 32..4096, default 720; requires targets.
inputs.realtime: Boolean, default false. Explicit user-visible preview via Viewport.refresh/adsk.doEvents on the same UI thread. Active document and command checked each frame and after events.
inputs.delay: Finite seconds 0..0.1, default 0; nonzero requires realtime:true. Bounded synchronous delay, not real-time timing accuracy.

limitations: Kinematic samples, not FEA, dynamics, contact solving, continuous collision verification or persistent native storyboard actions.

Requires active valid target document, idle/SelectCommand, non-Animation workspace, timeline end and no pending positions. Never switches workspace. Shared wrapper may activate the scoped document before the handler.

Original values of all exposed DOFs must be within enabled limits even when restore:false. Native/proxy/external mutation eligibility is deferred to joint.drive; a later invalid track can fail after earlier tracks move. Inspect every native joint before sampling.
No computeAll after joint.drive: recomputing can reset positions. Reads actual values after all tracks are driven, not just requested interpolation.
Restoration is not rollback. Captured snapshots and document modified state can remain. Untracked solver-coupled state is not verified; unrelated objects are not deleted.
If events change document/command/workspace, sampling aborts and unsafe restoration is skipped with explicit restoreErrors. No background thread, auto-save or document close.

Files are not written by default; exported nonempty files are reported, not claimed as video. Completed frame exports remain on failure. Atomic no-overwrite publication requires filesystem hard-link support; no overwrite fallback. Owned temporary export directories are cleaned up.

animation.joints.summary: Alias of motion.sample: explicit bounded joint-track sampling, actual values, optional checks/PNG files, default finally restoration.

inputs.tracks: As motion.sample: 1..64 distinct joint refs with explicit rotation and/or slide {from,to} dimensional expressions.
inputs.restore: Boolean, default true; motion/camera restoration, not rollback.
inputs.checks: At most 64 check inputs, prevalidated and measured per frame.
inputs.frameFiles: Exactly frameCount nonexisting PNG targets with existing parents. CLI maps WSL/native paths like other exports; handler receives absolute native Fusion-machine paths. Mutually exclusive with directory/prefix; no overwrite.
inputs.directory: CLI-mapped WSL/native output directory, which must already exist on the Fusion machine. No automatic directory creation, default output or overwrite.
inputs.prefix: 1..64 ASCII letters/digits/_/-, default frame; requires directory.
inputs.realtime: Boolean, default false; guarded synchronous UI refresh/events.

limitations: Same contract and limitations as motion.sample. Not FEA/dynamics, native storyboard actions or video publishing.

Original values of all exposed DOFs must be within enabled limits even when restore:false. A later proxy/external track can fail joint.drive after earlier tracks move because eligibility is not fully preflighted; inspect all native joints first.
Restores tracked joint motion and camera by default; snapshots/modified state and untracked solver-coupled state are not rolled back. Failures and restoreErrors are separate.

No workspace switch, recompute, save, close or background callbacks. Existing shared wrapper may activate the scoped document. PNG publication requires filesystem hard-link support for atomic no-overwrite.
